entities.name: Severo Jr.
entities.description: A vengeful human man in New Capenna with a personal vendetta against Anhelo; his own schemes led to his demise.

entities.name: New Capenna
entities.description: Plane where the events take place.

entities.name: Severo Sr.
entities.description: Severo's father, allegedly killed by Anhelo.

entities.name: Riveteers
entities.description: Faction whose transport Severo crashed into; they tried to retrieve stolen Halo.

entities.name: Toluz
entities.description: Intervened to stop the Riveteers from killing Anhelo.

events.summary: Disguised as Antonio Swift, Severo tricks Anhelo into taking a cab ride.
events.quote: Severo, disguised as Antonio Swift, tricked Anhelo into taking a cab ride.

events.summary: Severo reveals his identity and accuses Anhelo of killing his father Severo Sr.
events.quote: He accused Anhelo of killing his father, Severo Sr., on his birthday three years prior.

events.summary: Anhelo stabs Severo in the chest with his dagger, but the cab still flies off the road and crashes into a Riveteer transport.
events.quote: Angelo reached out and stabbed Severo in the chest with his dagger

events.summary: Severo laughs even while dying, leaving Anhelo injured and surrounded by Riveteers.
events.quote: Severo laughed maniacally even while dying

events.summary: Toluz's timely intervention stops the Riveteers from killing Anhelo.
events.quote: Only Toluz 's timely intervention stopped Anhelo from being killed by the Riveteers
